name: python-vuln-responder
description: Find and fix vulnerable PyPI packages across every Python environment, lockfile and Dockerfile. Advisory-driven: Pillow < 13.0.0 and HTTP2Shell (Brotli < 1.2.1, brotlicffi < 1.2.1.0). Flags Pythons too old for the fix, reads distro backports, optional OSV.dev check, fix plans and EN/ES comms.
